title: Travel Agents: Taiwan  ·  v6.2
subtitle: Your turn = ONE action. Then if your Larder holds over 7, discard down to 7 (to that region's market discard — it reshuffles in when the deck runs dry).

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: VISIT the local market (where you stand) — flip top 3 of this region's ingredient deck; any EVENT fires now (by scope); keep up to 2 ingredients.
CONVENIENCE STORE (anywhere) — flip top 1 of ANY region's ingredient deck: ingredient -> take it; event -> it fires by scope. The reliable way to grab 糖.
TRAVEL — move to a neighbouring region (HSR = North<->South), then flip top 1 there: ingredient -> take it; event -> nothing, keep moving.
PROMOTE (with the vendor, in this region) — place 2 Buzz on face-up vendor(s) here. Buzz stays on the card, public; your rival can pile on too.
BRIBE A VENDOR — win a face-up vendor by out-hyping your rival (below). Moves the day-clock +1.
CLAIM A TOUR TICKET — take 1 from the face-up row of 3 (this phase's pool); refill the row. Only one you haven't already completed. Scores into your piles later.

sections.heading: Bribe = out-hype, on the spot (one rule for every vendor)
lines: 1) be WITH the vendor, in its region;  2) hold at least 2 MORE Buzz on it than your rival;  3) pay its ingredients minus your matching region discount icons (Buzz is NEVER discounted).
Gain Prestige (score up) + Reputation (marker up) + its perk. Then clear ALL Buzz on it (yours + rival's), refill the slot, day-clock +1. FOOD carries a region discount icon; DRINKS carry none.

sections.heading: Events — the island living its life (⦿ / ⬢ / ➤, measured from the drawn region)
lines: ⦿ YOU (the flipper)  ·  ⬢ THIS REGION (everyone standing there)  ·  ➤ NEXT DOOR (a neighbour). Hazards TAX or delay — never destroy what you hold, never cost a whole turn.

sections.heading: The day-clock: Day -> Night (every Bribe moves it +1)
lines: DUSK = the 5th table-wide Bribe (2p): judge every DAYTIME ticket, then clear the ENTIRE day layer island-wide -> night decks (event-heavier), swap the ticket row to night. Keep your Larder.
LAST TRAIN = the 10th Bribe (2p): judge every NIGHTTIME ticket, then finish the round + one more full round and stop. (Marks grow with player count.)

sections.heading: Score once, at game end
lines: Prestige (sum of your vendors) + Reputation end-VP for your FINAL position (3/6/9/top -> +2/+4/+6/+9) + Tour Tickets.
Tickets: +printed value for each in your 成團 WIN pile;  -floor(value/2) for each in your 遺珠 LOSE pile.  Most points = TOP AGENT (ties: Reputation, then most vendors, then most regions).
